content: Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience building cloud-based data platforms, distributed ETL pipelines, and AI-enabled analytics solutions across e-commerce, pricing analytics, supply chain, and reporting environments.

Skilled in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, AWS, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, and Delta Lake for developing scalable batch and near real-time processing systems supporting machine learning, forecasting, and operational analytics. Experienced in Lakehouse architecture, workflow orchestration, cloud migration, CI/CD automation, and distributed data processing with strong focus on performance optimization, data reliability, and analytics delivery.
